name: Boneshatter Juggernaut
summary: League-start melee build. Boneshatter trades a little life for stacks, so the gear is armour and resistances, the axe is a rare with attack speed, and the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable. Herald of Purity and Vulnerability turn the axe into damage, and no unique is required, which is what a strength build needs on day one of a solo league.

sub.watch: Cleave with Added Fire Damage and Faster Attacks carries acts 1-2. Keep a mana flask, because slam attacks are mana-hungry before leech, and do not spend currency on a rare axe yet.

Stay on Sunder into the next step and do not fix the stretch with currency.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.
The two-handed gear profile no longer inherits a shield; armour rolls and a chaos belt raise life, EHP and max hit at every map checkpoint.
Weapon-scoped tree targets stop points going to one-hand and mace-crit notables under Resolute Technique.
Herald of Purity, Vulnerability, Added Fire Damage and a Silver Flask raise measured DPS; re-rated S+.
The weapon carries mana leech, a mana flask covers the 28-67 stretch, and the gate report now publishes unreserved mana and mana cost.
The leveling filter and step plans were corrected for Resolute Technique and the 5-link/6-link wording.
The 28-38 step now has its own 41-point tree and stays on Sunder; Boneshatter starts at 39 with Brutality and its own gate report.
The 39-68 step shows the support progression and keeps a mana flask until the axe carries leech.
Ascendancy labs are named correctly: Unflinching, Unbreakable, Undeniable and Unrelenting.

summary.text: Boneshatter Juggernaut is a two-handed melee build that measures 439.5k at red maps and 660.4k at pinnacle. The rare axe, armour rolls and Herald of Purity carry the damage, the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Cleave and Added Fire Damage until Sunder is available, then stay on Sunder for the measured stretch. Brutality is already usable before the swap; the guide moves to Boneshatter at the next step, because the Sunder checkpoint is what the gate measures. A better two-handed axe is an upgrade, not a gate. The first checkpoint measures 425 life and 41 damage; the second measures 1.5k with a self-cast Vulnerability. The mana flask covers you until the rare axe carries leech; the Silver Flask comes with that axe.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 439.5k damage, 30206 effective life and 12237 physical max hit. Herald of Purity is the damage aura and a level-capped Vulnerability rides on Cast when Damage Taken; the axe's mana leech keeps the quarter-full mana bar up. Cap the elemental resistances, keep the axe current, and swap Close Combat for Melee Splash when you want faster packs.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 660.4k damage with 39287 effective life and 15201 physical max hit. Use Enduring Cry before the burst, keep Vulnerability up, and keep the trauma stacks running while you move out of the biggest slams.
